title: feat(plugin-auth): an IdP group mapping says whether it matches a current group of its source
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLcR66HDKGmkegYSEN3PSwY)_

Fixes #32121

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`sys_idp_group_mapping` 多了三个只读列：`match_status`（已匹配 / 未匹配任何当前组 / 不适用）、`matched_group_id`、`match_changed_at`，`all` 列表视图显示匹配状态。plugin-auth 在 SCIM 组的创建、改名（PATCH/PUT）、删除和映射保存时自动更新它们，每次启动再全量对账一次。
- 为什么改：IdP 把组改名后，成员的授权会立刻失效（正确的 fail-closed），但映射行上什么也看不出来；cloud 的 SCIM 控制台（cloud#4278 第 4 项）需要显示「不匹配任何当前组」。
- 风险与回滚：只描述、不决定授权：谁拿到哪个权限集完全不变，不匹配的映射仍然什么也不授予。更新失败不会让 SCIM 请求失败（只记 error 日志，下次写入或重启时自愈）。回滚即还原本 PR，三个列留空无害。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/idp-group-mapping-match.ts`（钩子与对账，重点看 `onGroupUpdate` 的跳过条件和 `refresh` 的 catch），`auth-plugin.ts` 里 kernel:ready 的注册与启动对账，`sys-idp-group-mapping.object.ts` 的三个新字段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/scim-group-projection.test.ts -t "rename the group"`，预期 1 例通过（改名后 `unmatched` 且无授权，改回后 `matched` 且授权恢复）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`sys_idp_group_mapping`** (`packages/platform-objects`): three new read-only fields in a `Match` group. `match_status` (select: `matched`, `unmatched`, `not_applicable`), `matched_group_id` (the `sys_scim_group` id it matches, empty when none), `match_changed_at` (when either last changed). `match_status` joins the `all` list view's columns. The data API stays `apiMethods: ['list']`, so nothing outside plugin-auth can write them.
- **`idp-group-mapping-match.ts`** (new, `plugin-auth`): judges each mapping with the projection's own matcher (`mappingMatchesGroup`), so "matches" means exactly what the grant path means. Engine after-hooks keep the answer current:
  - `sys_scim_group` `afterInsert` / `afterDelete`, and `afterUpdate` when `display_name`, `external_id` or `connection_id` moved, re-judge that connection's mappings;
  - `sys_idp_group_mapping` `afterInsert`, and `afterUpdate` when a key column moved, re-judge the row's source; an SSO row is marked `not_applicable`.
  - A row is written only when its answer changed, so the mapping's history shows real transitions only, and a membership change writes nothing.
  - A failure is caught and logged at `error` (consequence + how it heals), never thrown: a SCIM write that 500s is retried by the IdP forever.
- **`auth-plugin.ts`**: binds the trigger at `kernel:ready` beside the other identity triggers, then runs `refreshAllMappingMatches` once, so rows saved before this release read right after the upgrade.
- **Translations**: regenerated with the repo's extractor (`os i18n extract … --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr,pt-BR,ru,de,ko --fill=default --source-hashes`), new leaves translated in all ten locales, then extracted again so the source-hash companions settle.

### Why engine hooks and not only the projection

Measured on the vendor (`@better-auth/scim` 1.7.12): `roles.map` is called from `buildDesiredGrants`, which returns early when the group has no members, so an empty group's create or rename never reaches the projection. Every vendor group write (`create`, `update`, `incrementOne`, `delete`) ends in an ObjectQL engine call by id through `objectql-adapter.ts`, so an after-hook sees all of them, inside the SCIM request's ambient engine transaction. Pinned by the empty-group case below.

### Field names

The card suggested `matched_group_id` + `matched_at`. I kept `matched_group_id` and used `match_changed_at` in place of `matched_at`: one timestamp answers both "matched since" and "matches nothing since", where `matched_at` is empty exactly when the console needs a date. `match_status` carries the three-way answer the card asks for (an SSO mapping reads "not applicable") so a list view can filter on it without combining `source_kind` and an empty id.

## Tests

New top-level `describe`s in the shared harness `scim-group-projection.test.ts` (real `AuthManager.handleRequest` over `@better-auth/scim`, real ObjectQL over better-sqlite3; the trigger is bound in the pool's boot, so every existing case there now runs with it too):

- rename the group (SCIM `PATCH replace displayName`) → `unmatched`, `matched_group_id` empty, `match_changed_at` set, member's grant gone; rename back → `matched`, grant back (the card's test);
- a mapping saved before its group exists reads `unmatched`; a memberless group push makes it `matched`; `DELETE /Groups` makes it `unmatched`;
- a mapping by external id keeps its answer when only the display name changes (`PUT`);
- a membership change writes nothing to the mapping row;
- an SSO-sourced row reads `not_applicable`;
- the boot sweep rights a row with empty match columns and a second sweep writes nothing;
- a failure to write the mapping never fails the SCIM rename: the rename lands, the grant follows, one `error` line names the connection;
- `AuthPlugin` registers the five hooks under one package id at `kernel:ready` and the sweep reads the mappings.

### Ablations (each mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)

| # | mutation | case | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | rethrow inside the hook's `catch` | failure never fails the SCIM write | red: `SCIM PATCH /Groups rename failed: expected 500 to be less than 300` |
| A2 | drop the `afterUpdate` hook on `sys_scim_group` | rename → unmatched | red: `expected { status: 'matched', … } to match object { status: 'unmatched', groupId: null }` |
| A3 | drop `settle`'s no-change guard | boot sweep | red: `a second sweep finds nothing to write: expected 1 to be +0` |
| A4 | drop the `afterDelete` hook on `sys_scim_group` | memberless group / delete | red: `expected { status: 'matched', … } to match object { status: 'unmatched', groupId: null }` |

A1's first attempt was refused by the tool (the replacement contained the anchor, so it ran nothing); it was re-run with a different anchor and went red as above. Not pinned behaviourally: the `onGroupUpdate` column filter is an efficiency guard (with it removed, `settle` still writes nothing on a membership change), so no case can tell it apart.

## Acceptance notes

- Fail-closed is unchanged: no line of `scim-group-projection.ts` or of the grant path moved.
- A raw driver write below the engine is not seen by the hooks; the boot sweep corrects it at the next start (said in the module header).
- File surface: besides the order's named files, `auth-plugin.ts` (the `kernel:ready` registration, the only place plugin-auth binds engine hooks) and the new module that holds the group lifecycle path. Two more, each forced by a gate or a test this change moved:
  - `durability-swallow-repair.test.ts`: its SCIM-stamp case captured the LAST `afterInsert` handler `AuthPlugin` registers, so the new hooks displaced it (`expected "vi.fn()" to be called at least once`). It now captures the handler registered under the plugin's own package id, which is the stamp; its assertions are unchanged.
  - `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`: the new engine write is one more census site (293, was 292; undecidable 90, provably carrying none 11). Generated sections rewritten by `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`; the seven prose figures the gate holds to the census edited to the numbers it printed. That includes the historical "over-claim" paragraph (67 → 68, 10 → 11), which the gate binds to the live counts. The site mirrors its sibling `delete` in `idp-group-mapping-admin.ts` (same row shape: `undecidable`, `PROVABLY NONE`).

## Verification

Head `8eeae2b2c0` (branch merged with `origin/main` at `cc8c4b0f4e`, no conflicts, nothing on this surface moved upstream).

- Full `npx turbo run build --concurrency=2` on the merged head: 120 of 120 tasks successful (os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` exit 0 in the same locked run. `@objectstack/platform-objects` typecheck exit 0 (before the merge; the merge touched neither package).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 120 files, 1934 tests passed (before the merge).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` (before the merge): 254 of 255 files passed, 1 failed (the `durability-swallow-repair.test.ts` capture described above). After the fix, `src/durability-swallow-repair.test.ts` + `src/scim-group-projection.test.ts`: 2 files, 52 tests passed. The merge touched no plugin-auth file.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on every touched `.ts` file: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `8eeae2b2c0`: 108 families, every one run, every one `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Includes `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:published-files`.
- CI families outside the derived set (artifact roster, wide-population families, type-check lanes, Test Core shards, dogfood): read from this PR's check-runs; not re-run locally. No full dogfood run: the title has no `!` and the Clause-② line carries the `(widening)` arm.
